method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record and all three attachments. Downloaded and extracted originals, compared their legislative status, and rendered the image-only enactment alongside the existing canonical archive page by page.

result: Retain the existing signed R-2025-031 canonical original once. The original packet and unsigned final are superseded; the separately downloaded enacted attachment is an identical delivery of that canonical signed record.
